system.description:
Shamans are very special combatants who are chosen by a special spirit known as a Lordling. With the right guidance and with enough gathered strength, the Lordling will one day become a Great Spirit. Shamans command their Lordlings in battle with Tactics, they can be physical fighters or evokers or a mix of both, and can use their Lordling to dominate the battlefield. Lordlings have unique forms and abilities to choose from.

Level 1 — Bonded Lives

Your Health starts at 6, and you gain 2 Health every time you gain a level.

Lordling

Your Lordling's maximum Health is equivalent to yours. This is unaffected by an increase to your Maximum Health via items or Hexes. Increases to your Maximum Health from Techniques or Stats do in turn increase the Lordling's Maximum Health.

Your Lordling starts with 10 Stat Points. Lordlings have 4 Stats: Spirit, Agility, Grit, and Will. Spirit determines their damage, Agility improves their ability to Dodge/Evade, Grit raises their Physical Resistance, Will raises their Magykal Resistance. Each Lordling Stat can be raised to a max of 5.

Lordlings have access to Physical Talents and 5 Talent Points to distribute into them. Should a Lordling have to roll a Social Talent or Sense, the Shaman rolls their own corresponding Talent and Senses.

Your Lordling has Movement and Running Speed equal to yours. Abilities that increase Movement-type Speeds only work on Lordlings if applied to them directly. You control your Lordlings movement during Player Phase.

Your Lordling cannot benefit at all from Elixirs.

Your bond with your Lordling allows you to communicate telepathically for a distance of up to 6 Spaces. Whether your Lordling speaks to others is up to you.

Tactics

Used for commanding your Lordling in combat. You must be within telepathic range to issue a Tactic. You have a total of 6 Tactic Points to start with. Each Tactic has a Focused and Swift Action variation. You regain all expended Tactic Points whenever a new Engagement begins.

  • Attack — Focused: 0 TP | Swift: 1 TP — Once per round your Lordling can make a Quick Attack while in the Medium or Huge Size.
  • Heal — Focused: 1 TP, 1x Per Engagement | Swift: 3 TP — Your Lordling heals an amount equal to your Arcana.
  • Dodge/Evasion — Swift: 0 TP, 1 Stamina — You instruct your Lordling to Dodge or Evade.
  • Return — Ritual — Should your Lordling fall in battle you can reconstitute its physical form by performing a 1hr long ritual. This can only be performed once between rests.
  • Metamorph — Focused: 0 TP | Swift: 1 TP — You change your Lordlings form to another Aspect.

Lordly Aspects

Lordlings can change their form and embody different parts of their power via the Metamorph Tactic. At level 1, you can learn any 3 Aspect Features.

  • Aspect of the Wild: Your Lordling becomes Medium size and gains access to any Wild Aspect Features it knows.
  • Aspect of the Royals: Your Lordling becomes Huge size, gaining the player effects of being huge, and gains access to any Royals Aspect Features it knows.
  • Aspect of the Spirit: A collection of features your Lordling can use, regardless of form.

Outside of an engagement, your Lordling adopts a Small sized form that cannot make use of any of its Aspect Features. Once you roll for an engagement, it automatically enters one of its two Aspect Forms at the beginning of combat.

Level 4 — Expanding Bond

Your telepathic bond range increases by 2 Spaces. Your Tactic Point total increases by 1.

Mystic Blessings

Your Movement increases by 2 and you increase one of your Senses by 2.

Lordly Aspects II

Select any one Aspect Feature for your Lordling to learn.

Tactics II

  • Retreat — Focused: 0 TP | Swift: 1 TP — You command your Lordling to move directly towards you in an effort to get them out of danger. They can move 6 Spaces, this does not count against their movement.
  • Transfer Talent — Focused: 1 TP | Swift: 2 TP — You can add any of your Lordlings Physical Talents to your own or vice versa for one minute to a maximum of 5, doing so makes the other creatures transferred talent 0 for the duration.

Level 8 — Expanding Bond II

Your telepathic bond range increases by 2 Spaces. Your Tactic Point total increases by 1.

Lordly Aspects III

Select any two Aspect Features for your Lordling to learn.

Memories of Past Lives

You gain 3 Mastery Points.

Desperate Strength

When your Lordling is destroyed, you harbor their spirit essence and can draw on it for strength. As a Swift Action you regain 10 Health, 3 Mana and restore your Stamina to full. Doing so drains your Lordlings essence and prevents you from performing the Return Ritual until you rest for eight hours.

Level 12 — Expanding Bond III

Your telepathic bond range increases by 2 Spaces. Your Tactic Point total increases by 1.

Lordly Aspects IV

Select any one Aspect Feature for your Lordling to learn.

Spirit Armament

Once per Engagement you can suffuse your Soul Armament with spiritual energy as a Swift Action to gain new power. You gain one of the following benefits for 5 Rounds:

  • Physical: Your Focused Attacks deal 4 additional damage.
  • Magykal: Your Hex Attacks deal 4 additional damage.

Level 15 — Unbreakable Bond

Your telepathic range is limitless, even across the different realms of existence and the Moons of Alstoria. Your Tactic Point total increases by 3.

Lordly Aspects V

Select any one Aspect Feature for your Lordling to learn.

Approximate Ascension | Focused Action | 3 Mana

For the next 3 Rounds you and your Lordling gain the following benefits:

  • Your Lordling becomes Massive size.
  • Shaman and Lordling raise each others stats by an amount equal to their own Stats and can surpass limits.
  • Your Lordling can utilize ALL aspects without needing to change Lordling forms.
  • Your maximum Tactic Points is doubled, but you do not regain any previously expended Tactic Points.
  • You gain access to the Spirits Wrath and Spirits Compassion Tactics.

Spirits Wrath (Tactic) | Focused | 7 TP, 2 Stamina, 2 Mana: You unleash a massive breath in a straight line that is 14 spaces long and 3 spaces wide. This breath deals damage equal to [4x Arcana] and has Evasion Value of 15.

Spirits Compassion (Tactic) | Focused | 7 TP, 2 Stamina, 2 Mana: You unleash a wave of healing onto the battlefield. Every allied creature within 6 spaces of you regains 15 Health. You do not regain Health from this Tactic.
